correctness.rationale: A direct stationary two-state generator derivation and a closed two-time regression prove the full covariance for all positive kappa, nu and D. Its right derivatives recover D, Sigma, Pi; quadratic inversion gives precisely the two aliases including the self-dual boundary. A separately solved fourth-moment generator system gives a strictly affine invariant-fiber formula and unique inversion. Independent characteristic-function expansion and symbolic/matrix-exponential checks confirm the identities; numerical sampling is not treated as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The evaluated claim is the complete inverse equivalence for all stationary two-time position covariances, not the prior generator or one-time variance and fourth-moment formulas. Direct comparison with the 2021 and 2024 primary texts found that neither identifies the exact two-to-one parameter map or proves its fourth-moment separation. Seven actual semantic record searches and searches of accessible prior claims located no covering statement. This supports qualified originality, not absolute priority; general two-state linear-system inverse theory may subsume the claim.
residual_risks: No independent external audit: proof and novelty were evaluated with same-model methods.
A general two-state Markov-modulated linear-diffusion identification theorem, especially outside indexed publications, might already imply the present twofold aliasing result.
The 2024 forward moment recurrence is prior; this claim deliberately excludes novelty for that recurrence or for the stationary fourth moment itself.
Finite-sample noisy estimation of zero-lag derivatives or fourth moments has not been investigated.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural identifiability/non-identifiability classification in a known physical model. It distinguishes a full time-lag covariance, normally thought informative for kinetic rates, from the extra fourth moment needed to lift the exact hidden twofold ambiguity. It is not a mere restatement of the published stationary m4 nor a routine parameter substitution: the full covariance equivalence and exhaustive inverse are the structural claims.
